decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family represents tooling and catalogue investment, and only one year on the market is too early to judge, so management persists with it.
The mitred handle family carries sunk design and tooling costs and fits the firm's architectural hardware line, so dropping it after a single year would be hard to justify.
The multifunctional handle is a deliberate innovation the firm has committed to, and weak early uptake can still be put down to the normal lag in specification cycles.
This is a single handle model with modest visibility, but it was only recently launched and its invested costs argue for keeping it for now.
The collection has its own page and won the 2023 German Design Award, a strong public commitment and success signal that makes keeping it nearly certain.
The new bronze finish extends the existing finish range at low marginal cost and supports the firm's premium direction, so it stays.
